original_test_intent: Confirm that the platform-required ACPI BERT, ERST and HEST error-record tables are exposed and recognized under the OS.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Inspect BERT/ERST/HEST under the OS and collect supporting logs.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Required tables should be found in dmesg.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE, with platform expectations still required for a final result.
historical_reviews.v3: Reclassified to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because table applicability and acceptance are platform-specific.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: No interactive activity is inherently required; engineering supplies the platform table matrix and adjudicates absent or invalid tables.
required_user_inputs: Required, conditional and not-applicable table matrix

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Inspect BERT, ERST and HEST exposure without assuming all are mandatory on every architecture.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Exact platform applicability matrix and acceptance criteria.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A not-applicable table may be omitted only by explicit platform mapping; a grep-only check does not prove table validity.

original_method: Retain OS log inspection and add read-only sysfs table inventory/metadata; do not clear dmesg before evidence collection.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Collect contextual kernel ACPI/APEI messages plus `/sys/firmware/acpi/tables/{BERT,ERST,HEST}` metadata or approved hashes/dumps and compare to the project matrix.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: ACPI specification defines the table mechanisms; the platform specification determines which tables apply.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Distinguishes presence, permission failure, invalid initialization and not-applicable status rather than relying on one grep hit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Still validates exposure only; it does not exercise error injection, ERST persistence or full RAS behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Generic ACPI documentation cannot supply a private platform's required table set.

safety_boundaries: Read-only inspection only; no error injection or firmware writes.
Preserve log history and protect remote credentials.
Do not claim end-to-end RAS validation.
expected_evidence: Table names, sizes and safe metadata/hashes
Contextual ACPI/APEI logs, command status and comparison
no_automatic_retry: A permission failure or missing table is preserved. Do not alter firmware/RAS configuration and retry without a new approved plan.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent can collect and compare against a supplied matrix; the platform owner decides whether absence or initialization errors are acceptable.
review_improvement: V3.1 narrows readiness more precisely than V3: safe read-only collection is ready now, while only the formal applicability verdict needs the project matrix. It remains REQUIRES INPUT rather than BLOCKED or falsely fully complete.
